principle: Introduce L04 V2 as a governed optional bridge/review layer, not by rewriting the frozen 32-level campaign.

reasoning: World 2 already establishes construction practice with VALI/PARAZAMI and prepares learners for controlled composition.
L04 V2 introduces scoped third-person questions and habituality before World 3 explicitly teaches anti-overgeneralization boundaries.
Keeping it interstitial avoids renumbering or replacing the frozen 32-level baseline.

sequence.goal: controlled habitual third-person activity questions; SARU remains every-day/habituality, never usually

pedagogy: EXPOSURE: encounter exact surface in a contextual micro-scene.
COMPREHENSION: choose the licensed local reading.
NOTICE: highlight only the scoped structure, not a universal formula.
RETRIEVAL: reconstruct/select the exact allowlisted surface.
TRANSFER-BOUNDARY: reject one nearby forbidden variant to teach negative space.
forbidden: No removal of KE to derive declarations.
No DAYI/SALI object or VEMI complements.
No SARU with DAYI or SALI.
No generated variants outside the eight-surface allowlist.

assessment.passCondition: All five families demonstrated without accepting forbidden variants
